exercise.instruction: Add a <style> block that makes all <h1> elements dark green (#166534), centered, and all elements with class 'card' get a light gray background (#f9fafb) and a 1px solid border (#e5e7eb).
hints: Hint 1: Style h1 first: h1 { color: #166534; text-align: center; }
Hint 2: Then the class: .card { background: #f9fafb; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; }
Hint 3: Selectors ending in { must close with }.

quiz.question: Which selector targets every element with class 'card'?
Which CSS property changes text color?
